ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of an organic reaction transition-state structure, and the curved arrows need to be ignored. At the upper right there is a separately labeled “:B” containing lone-pair dots, not drawn as connected to the main skeleton by an ordinary covalent bond. The main structure contains a six-membered unsaturated ring containing an imine nitrogen; C=N is visible at the lower-right position, and an adjacent C=C is also visible on the ring. On the left is a bridged hydrocarbon skeleton fused with this ring; a five-membered saturated nitrogen-containing ring, namely a pyrrolidinyl N-substituent, is connected to the central fused carbon. Reasoning: According to the method, first convert the non-arrow part into a connection graph. The separate boron label is written as [B] as an independent SMILES component. The main skeleton is encoded starting from the unsaturated six-membered ring containing the imine nitrogen, retaining C=N and the adjacent C=C, and can be written in a ring-closure form of C1=CC...C=N1. The left fused bridged hydrocarbon part is encoded as C2C3CCC(C3)C2 by closure through bridgehead carbons. The pyrrolidine substituent connected to the central carbon is written as N2CCCC2, and is linked as a branch to that central carbon. Combining these connections, the main molecule is C1=CC2C3CCC(C3)C2(N2CCCC2)C=N1. Finally, connect the independent boron component and the main molecule with a dot to obtain [B].C1=CC2C3CCC(C3)C2(N2CCCC2)C=N1.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First transcribe the non-arrow parts of the drawing into a connectivity graph. Encode the isolated boron label as a separate SMILES component '[B]'. For the main framework, start at the imine nitrogen-containing ring and assign ring indices around the unsaturated six-membered ring, preserving the C=N bond and the adjacent C=C bond. Add the fused bridged hydrocarbon portion by assigning closures through the bridgehead carbons, then attach the pyrrolidine substituent at the central carbon as 'N2CCCC2'. Combine the disconnected boron component and the main molecular graph with a dot to obtain '[B].C1=CC2C3CCC(C3)C2(N2CCCC2)C=N1'.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一幅有机反应过渡态结构示意图，弯箭头需要忽略。右上方有一个单独标注的含孤对点的“:B”，没有画成与主骨架的普通共价键连接。主结构包含一个含亚胺氮的六元不饱和环，右下位置可见 C=N，环上还可见相邻的 C=C。左侧是与该环稠合的桥环烃骨架；中心稠合碳上连接一个五元饱和含氮环，即吡咯烷基 N-取代基。
推理：按方法先把非箭头部分转成连接图。单独的硼标签作为一个独立 SMILES 组分写作 [B]。主骨架从含亚胺氮的不饱和六元环编码，保留 C=N 和邻近 C=C，可写成 C1=CC...C=N1 的环闭合形式。左侧稠合桥环烃部分通过桥头碳闭合编码为 C2C3CCC(C3)C2。中心碳上连接的吡咯烷取代基写作 N2CCCC2，并作为支链接到该中心碳。将这些连接合并，主分子为 C1=CC2C3CCC(C3)C2(N2CCCC2)C=N1。最后把独立硼组分与主分子用点号连接，得到 [B].C1=CC2C3CCC(C3)C2(N2CCCC2)C=N1。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the straightforward structure-transcription route: it treats the drawing as a molecular graph, removes only the curved-arrow annotations, and converts the remaining atoms/bonds directly into SMILES. With only one target structure, genuinely different routes are limited.
planner_metadata.image_role: Inspect the image to identify the actual drawn species after ignoring arrows: a separate boron atom labeled ':B' at the upper right; a fused bicyclic/polycyclic carbon framework containing a six-membered unsaturated C/N ring with a C=N bond; and a pyrrolidine substituent attached through its nitrogen to the central bridgehead carbon. Read solid bonds and ring fusions, but do not encode the curved arrows or transition-state motion arrows.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the required output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored; no other textual chemical data are needed.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard skeletal-structure conventions: unlabeled vertices are carbons with implicit hydrogens, labeled N and B atoms are explicit, double lines are double bonds, fused rings require ring-closure numbers in SMILES, disconnected components are separated by '.', and the boron atom with no drawn bonds is represented as '[B]'.
